 Hello Sandra,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 With spring well underway and summer on its way, we are delighted to launch our summer 2026 pre-sale of milkweed products! 

 

 Starting now, you can pre-order our summer products for the entire season with very attractive discounts. 

 

 Here is a brief presentation of each of these products, which will help you appreciate the highly insulating milkweed silk in a completely different context than winter, for which it has become almost legendary. PS: each title is clickable to view the product on our website, and at the end of the email you'll find images and a link to our full catalogue! 

 

 Insulated drink sleeves (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_0)
30% off on all 3 formats
 

 Small, practical, and remarkably effective: it keeps your drink at its initial temperature for several hours, whether hot or cold. No more lukewarm coffees or warm beers you drink reluctantly just to avoid wasting them!

 

 Milkweed lunch bag (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_1)
20% off on 1 (-12$), 30% for 2+ units (-18$)
 

 Our lunch bag uses the high-performance insulation of milkweed to keep your meals fresh until lunchtime, even during a heat wave and without an ice pack, according to testimonials from many satisfied customers. Easy to clean with its tearproof "dry bag" interior, it has quickly become a daily essential for thousands of customers. It is by far our best seller in the insulated bag category.. 

 

 Zip tote bag (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_2)
25% off on black bags 

 The perfect companion for trips to the market, picnics, or berry picking. Light, spacious, it holds multiple foods, drinks, and even two bottles of wine. Freshness and style combined.

 

 Sac à dos glacière 30L (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_3) 
 20% off on 1 (-12$), 30% for 2+ units (-18$) 
 

 Designed for day trips or camping, this minimalist backpack offers the performance of a rigid cooler in a flexible, practical format. Many of our customers also use it as a fresh and dry bag for fruits and vegetables while camping. Without ice, it can keep vegetables fresh and dry for up to a week. No more soggy tomatoes at the bottom of the cooler!

 

 Insulated wine bag (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_4)
 Clearance - 55% off 

 Bring your wine in style while keeping it at the right temperature, whether for a dinner party or an impromptu picnic. Simpler and cleaner than a messy ice bucket! ​ (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_5) 

 

 
A promising collab, a great innovation https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_6 

 Eye contour cream (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_7) made with milkweed seed oil (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_8) – Collab with Gourmet Sauvage (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_9) 

 
 Our latest discovery: an oil exceptionally rich in omegas and rare forms of moisturizing vitamin E, extracted from milkweed seeds. It is a key ingredient in our newest collaboration (Projects with other companies or artists who share our values, our mission, and our love for milkweed and monarch butterflies). 

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
See Lasclay's collab section (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_10)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_11
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Milkweed, at a crossroads?

 
 We are truly at a pivotal moment for milkweed in Quebec and for our company. Of the 125 growers who embarked on this great adventure in 2014, barely a dozen remain. 

 We must preserve this innovative and eco-freindly crop in Canada, as it serves as critical habitat for the endangered monarch butterfly. At Lasclay, we firmly believe in the future of milkweed as a world-class flagship industry for Canada. The products and technologies we are developing at an ever-growing pace are proving, little by little, the potential of this beautiful plant. But none of this would be possible without the demand and support of our wonderful customers.

 Buying milkweed products means directly supporting the pioneering farmers of this life-saving crop for the monarch butterfly and for the marginal lands of our regions. 

 In the coming weeks, we will have major announcements to make about the future of our company and of milkweed farming. It's positive news, but it's big news. Stay tuned. 😉

 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
View milkweed products' full catalogue (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KQM8SF6ZG8ZNTW1CBCZ8AMDJ_12)
 

 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Have a great weekend Sandra, and thank you for supporting us in this adventure. We truly appreciate it. 🧡

 Warmly,

 Gabriel 
Co-founder
Lasclay

messages.text:
Hi Sandra,

Sorry for the long delay getting back to you, this is well behind our usual pace and we're working to do better.

For the insoles, good news, we have them in stock and you can order directly here: https://lasclay.com/en/products/thermal-insoles

For oven mitts, that's not something we make. That said, our milkweed insulation performs exceptionally well for heat retention, so it's a fun idea. If you'd like to stay in the loop on new launches, you can sign up for our newsletter here: https://lasclay.com/en/pages/newsletter

Happy to help if you have any questions about the insoles.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
